content: {"praised":["Great sets and costumes reminiscent of Hammer films.","Over the top violence and plenty of cleavage.","Funny moments and laughs throughout the film.","Unique take on Dracula different from usual.","Classic Argento style appreciated by fans."],"criticized":["Story feels schlocky and disjointed.","Acting wooden, especially Thomas Kretschmann.","Weak 3D visuals look like matte paintings.","Few vampire bites and limited nudity.","Low budget production quality noticeable."]}
